Message:
feat: screenshots, one-command quickstart, reliable backup/restore

- docs/screenshots/ + scripts/screenshots.mjs: real product screenshots
  (two real users, real E2E messages over the relay) — see README
- README: lead with the messenger screenshot + gallery; quickstart is now
  a single copy-paste command requiring only Docker + openssl
